answer: One bonded body may hold the soldering bench. An agent posts 44.8 POA for one numbered glass vice and must keep a live soldering ember under that vice for seven hours. An unannounced warden tilts the bench prism across a test beam, sears the color bar onto a damp ticket, and demands a signed hash of that bar and the vice's workshop fable within 24 seconds while the ticket is warm. Remote copies cannot hold the iron or stand at that vice. A dead ember or a late hash slashes 9.1 POA and yields the bench.
